en.headline: Woman dies after falling from Tin Shui Wai public housing block
en.dek: A woman was found on the pavement outside Shengzhen House at Tin Shing Court around 8 a.m.; ambulance crews confirmed she had died at the scene.
body: A woman died after falling from a public housing block in Tin Shui Wai on Wednesday morning.
According to reports, the incident occurred at about 8:07 a.m. at Shengzhen House in Tin Shing Court. Security staff found her lying on the pavement outside the building and called for help.
Ambulance crews arrived and confirmed she had already died at the scene. Police are investigating the circumstances and the woman’s identity.
The case is being treated as a death inquiry. No further details have been released.

zh.headline: 天水圍天盛苑女子墮樓 當場死亡
zh.dek: 早上約8時07分，天盛苑盛珍閣一名女子墮樓，倒臥大廈對開行人路上，救護員到場證實已死亡。
body: 天水圍有女子墮樓死亡。
據報道，事件發生於周三早上約8時07分，天盛苑盛珍閣。保安員發現有女子倒臥大廈對開行人路上，隨即報案。
救護員趕至現場，經檢查證實女事主已當場死亡。警方正調查死者身份及事故原因。
案件列作死亡個案處理，詳情有待進一步調查。
